full_tree_check.description: Every file under outputs/ (excluding external_ifc_check.json, produced by a separate script and compared separately) from two independent 'python run.py --output <dir>' executions, compared byte-for-byte by SHA-256.

note: v0.1 established byte-identical reproduction for six numerical outputs only. The v1.0 execution audit extends this to the entire output tree, including every experiments/*.ifc fault-injection fixture, after fixing the non-determinism documented in docs/AUDIT_V0_2_TO_V1_0.md.
